name: Parallel Codex Runners
summary: Plan and supervise independent Codex task runners with AgentPlane run observability.
description: Adds an operator recipe for splitting approved work into independent AgentPlane tasks, launching each through the Codex runner, and monitoring progress with task run status, inspect, and logs commands.

skills.summary: Coordinates multiple independent Codex task runners without sharing lifecycle authority.

agents.summary: Splits approved work into independent runner tasks and monitors their run artifacts.

scenarios.name: Coordinate Parallel Codex Runners
scenarios.summary: Split safe work into independent AgentPlane tasks and supervise each Codex runner.
scenarios.description: Use this when a parent task has separable work packages that can run concurrently without writing the same files or sharing lifecycle authority.
use_when: The parent scope can be split into independent child tasks with non-overlapping file ownership.
Each child can produce its own verification evidence and result manifest.
You need live progress visibility while several Codex runners execute.
avoid_when: The work requires a single shared edit across the same files.
The task needs continuous human judgement before each child can proceed.
The workflow mode or policy requires one linear owner to perform all changes.
